Computer Science: focuses on algorithms, operating systems and computer organization; build strong data structures & algorithms and ship side projects.
Software Engineering: focuses on requirements, design, testing and project management; gain end-to-end engineering experience with mainstream frameworks.
Artificial Intelligence: focuses on ML, deep learning and math; strengthen linear algebra & probability and join competitions and open-source projects.
Data Science: focuses on cleaning, statistical analysis and visualization; master SQL, Python and business sense, think data-driven.
Network Engineering: focuses on networking, routing/switching and security; do hands-on labs and follow cloud networking & DevOps trends.
